text_en: During the IMF/World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Thailand, from October 14 to 17, PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng attended meetings including the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable, the International Monetary and Financial Committee (IMFC) economic outlook briefing, and the Annual Meeting of the Institute of International Finance's Board of Trustees. Xuan Changneng said that the recent rise in risk-free interest rates in global financial markets has raised financing costs for developing countries and further increased their debt-service burden. All parties should strengthen multilateral cooperation, adhere to the principle of "joint action and fair burden-sharing," and explore effective implementation mechanisms for private-sector participation in debt restructuring on comparable terms. All parties should continue to promote improvement of the global sovereign debt governance system, improve the IMF and World Bank low-income country debt sustainability analysis frameworks, properly define the scope of public debt, and strengthen information sharing with creditors.
